locations.title: Trail of Breadcrumbs

locations.title: Hansel and Gretel (or what's left of them)
locations.description: After following the [Trail of Breadcrumbs](#loc=595181) to this [Interesting Site](#loc=535424), you'll find some small bones - presumably those of Hansel and Gretel - in the furnace and a nearby cage.

locations.title: Witch
locations.description: It seems likely that a witch lost control of her broomstick and had a crash landing here, with a woman's corpse found straddling a broomstick, wearing a wide, dark hat, and having what appears to be a magic wand near her hand.

locations.title: Otesánek
locations.description:
A boot-wearing tree with hands and teeth at this [Interesting Site](#loc=538552) references Otesánek, a Czech fairy tale.

A childless couple finds a baby-shaped log in in the wood that comes to life and asks to be fed. No matter how much they feed the baby, its hunger grows until it begins to eat people - its parents included. 

Eventually, Otesánek is killed when its belly is cut open, freeing everyone he ate - though in this version, it seems the devoured folks were not so lucky.

locations.title: Dabbing Skeleton
locations.description: The skeleton in this [Grave](#loc=535042) is, as the kids of 2016 would say, 'hitting the dab.'

locations.title: Hot Fuzz reference
locations.description: Talmberg's [Huntsman](#loc=535193), Nicholas Angel, shares his name with the protagonist of the British film Hot Fuzz.

locations.title: William Tell reference
locations.description:
The [Accident](#loc=535106) here bears a striking resemblance to William Tell's most famous feat.

Following his arrest after refusing to bow to the hat of Altdorf, Tell's only chance to avoid execution was to shoot an apple off the head of his son. 

He was successful in the legend, but here... his aim could use some work. Really, though, who can blame him? Aiming in Kingdom Come is bloody difficult!

locations.title: The Godfather reference
locations.description:
Upon digging up this [grave](#loc=535070), you'll be greeted by a corpse with the head of a horse in its lap.

The situation bears a striking resemblance to an iconic scene from The Godfather, linked above.

locations.title: Goatman
locations.description: The body in this [Grave](#loc=535063) has the body of a man and head of a horned animal, possibly referencing the Goatman cryptid.

locations.title: Ambush
locations.description: At the waterline, in the bushes
